mapper.delete: DELETE FROM app_iot_device_creation_request WHERE idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} AND expires_at <= #{now}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_iot_device_creation_request ( idempotency_key, request_hash, status, expires_at) VALUES (#{idempotencyKey}, #{requestHash}, 'PENDING', #{expiresAt}) ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING
